name: 11705 · Bayport, NY
findings: ZIP 11705 (Bayport) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11705 (Bayport) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 5 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
